'''Tumtum''' is a [[Nilo-Saharan languages|Nilo-Saharan language]] of the [[Kadu languages|Kadu]] branch spoken in [[South Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. Dialects are Karondi (Kurondi, Korindi), Talassa, and Tumtum proper.
